title: Describe the body format
summary: REST API Development: Describe the body format. Explain the difference between Accept and Content-Type.
introduction: Content-Type says what format a body uses. Accept says which response formats the client can understand.
learningObjectives: Describe the body format with REST API Development
Explain the difference between Accept and Content-Type

blocks.text: Read the request and response pairs in a text editor. They show only headers useful to each idea. No server, account or installation is needed for these exercises; /books is an imaginary practice API.

blocks.title: Describe the body format
blocks.code:
GET /books/1 HTTP/1.1
Host: example.test
Accept: application/json

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json

{"id":1}

blocks.text: Accept asks for JSON. The response Content-Type confirms that its body uses JSON.
Explain the difference between Accept and Content-Type.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: JSON text needs valid quoting; a header alone does not make invalid text valid JSON.
